tasks.name: R2 — Rich content in a non-DOM canvas (what we lose + mitigations)

An incremental migration plan behind a flag, task-cards-first

tasks.name: S1 — Spike: minimal substrate board (task cards) + zoom + crisp + focus-by-id

acceptance_criteria: A flagged spike route renders >=50 task nodes via the new substrate

frontend-design eval of fit→1000% screenshots: correct + crisp + supports worlds idea
Runs acceptably on the weak machine (record fps)

tasks.correctness: No per-card re-rasterization; size invariance comes from the camera matrix, not a counter-scale hack.

tasks.name: S0 — crisp-text discriminator micro-spike (DOM under single matrix() vs alternatives @10x)
acceptance_criteria: Standalone HTML+CSS harness (no CodeTerm build) renders styled text; Playwright zooms to 10x via a SINGLE container transform: matrix() and screenshots at device px

Compares: (A) pure single-container CSS matrix transform, (B) re-rasterize via font-size/layout at LOD thresholds, (C) will-change/layer hints — verdict on which stays CRISP at 10x without continuous reflow
Explicit empirical verdict resolving R1 (DOM-under-transform stays crisp) vs R2 (it blurs, need GPU MSDF) — with screenshots as evidence
tasks.test_plan: Playwright launches own Chromium against a local static HTML file; screenshot crops at 1x and 10x; frontend-design skill scores crispness; no dev daemon, no cargo build
tasks.correctness: Settles the idle-node renderer architecture for D1/S1; verdict must be backed by pixel evidence, not assertion

tasks.name: R3 — Research World/Figma canvas architecture
tasks.model_rationale: Architecture research is terminal/web/source-heavy; Codex 5.5 assigned per user's direction for deeper design reasoning.
acceptance_criteria: Defines the target architecture in one page: renderer substrate, camera model, node/content model, focused-node overlay strategy, and LOD/worlds semantics.
Explains why current Worlds v3/per-card crispScale path is rejected or retained only as temporary legacy.
Compares at least three options against our constraints: rich markdown/mermaid, crisp text at deep zoom, stable object geometry, hit-testing/selection, weak-machine performance, implementation cost.
Produces a first implementation slice with acceptance tests, but does not start implementation.
tasks.test_plan: Research deliverable: plan milestone/section with decision matrix + recommended architecture + migration slice. Verify by checking it directly answers the W2 shrink/wobble root cause and names the exact follow-up implementation task.
tasks.correctness: The result must answer which canvas/world architecture should replace the current Worlds v3 path, why it solves shrinking/wobble/reflow at the root, and what the first implementation slice should be.
